tasks.build:frontend: pnpm install -C frontend && pnpm run -C frontend build

build:backend:darwin:aarch.command: deno task compile:base --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output dist/potoo-macos-arm backend/main.ts

build:backend:darwin:x86.command: deno task compile:base --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output dist/potoo-macos-x86 backend/main.ts

build:backend:linux:aarch.command: deno task compile:base --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/potoo-linux-arm backend/main.ts

build:backend:linux:x86.command: deno task compile:base --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/potoo-linux-x86 backend/main.ts

tasks.check:backend: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check backend/main.ts
